stories.title: Ukraine strikes Moscow with hundreds of drones during Russian elections
new_facts: Ukraine launched massed drone attack on Moscow, 450 drones targeted city, oil refinery hit.
Strike killed 2 in Moscow region; separately Russian strikes on Kyiv region killed at least 4.
Over 1,000 drones fired at Russia overnight; Moscow region attack wounded 20, damaged residential building.
Moscow mayor says 1,600 drones intercepted; Russia accuses Ukraine of election interference.
Flights suspended at two Moscow airports following drone strikes.
Russia's air campaign hitting warehouses, steel plants, ports, railways cost Ukraine over $1.5bn in tax revenue.
Russia included annexed Ukrainian regions in its parliamentary elections; Kyiv and EU condemn move as illegal
stories.line: Ukraine launched its largest drone attack on Moscow, killing two, as Russia held parliamentary elections including annexed regions.

stories.title: Ed Sheeran addresses Gaza after Macklemore dropped from tour
new_facts: Sheeran also called the Hamas-led attack on Israel "horrific" during the speech
Sheeran addresses Gaza directly on stage, calling the situation 'catastrophic and unjustifiable'.
Sheeran tears up, says 'I cannot hide how I feel...anymore', reversing prior no-politics stance.
Sheeran apologizes on stage for 'making mistakes' regarding the tour controversy.
stories.line: Ed Sheeran publicly called Gaza situation 'catastrophic and unjustifiable' at a concert, after Macklemore was dropped from his tour over Gaza comments.
